name: Digital Marketing Course
seo_title: Online Digital Marketing Course in Azerbaijan
seo_description: A 3-month online digital marketing course taught in Azerbaijani: SEO, SMM, Meta and Google Ads, GA4. 10 modules, real cases, 1:1 mentoring. 99 AZN/month.

h1: Digital Marketing Course — online, from Azerbaijan
lede: A hands-on 3-month online programme in digital marketing: SEO, social media, Meta and Google advertising, Google Analytics and conversion optimisation. Taught by Zamir Shabanov.
summary: The Digital Marketing Course is Marketing School's 3-month online programme, taught in Azerbaijani. Across 10 modules it covers SEO, social media marketing, Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, conversion rate optimisation and email marketing. Lessons are recorded and can be watched at any time; live Q&A sessions run on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of every month, homework is based on real business cases, and every student gets a one-to-one mentoring session after completing the lessons. The course costs 99 AZN per month. Students who meet the assessment threshold receive a diploma. The instructor is Zamir Shabanov, Leading Digital Marketing Specialist at AzInTelecom.
focus: Execution: SEO, SMM, Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, conversion
for_whom_short: People who want practical skills and a quick start
card_text: SEO, social media, Meta and Google advertising, measurement in Google Analytics and turning more website visitors into customers — all on real cases.
overview: The course covers the core tools of digital marketing: getting a website to rank in search (SEO), social media content (SMM), Meta and Google advertising, measurement in Google Analytics and improving how well a website converts visitors into sales. Each module combines video lessons with homework based on a real business case. Twice a month, on the 2nd and 4th Saturday, the instructor answers your questions live, and once you have completed the lessons you book a one-to-one mentoring session.
